snippet.title: Crash Team Racing: Turbocharged | PC Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
###

Project info, downloads etc. now available! Go go go!
https://ctr.cmzi.uk/

###

With thanks to the High Octane, ctr-native and CTR modding communities whose work made this project possible.

###

What if we Turbocharged the original Crash Team Racing?

Introducing Crash Team Racing: Turbocharged, a PC-focused fork of High Octane, built on the work of the ctr-native project.

Rediscover the original tracks and characters with native-resolution rendering at 4K and beyond, widescreen and ultrawide support, frame-rate options up to 240 FPS, and sharper graphics with perspective-correct textures and maximum detail.

Adventure gets new conveniences too: automatic saving, character switching, independent engine selection, additional unlocks, and clearer menus and HUD elements. Adjust the presentation to your taste, from a classic PS1 look to the enhanced Turbocharged experience.

This reveal shows the visual comparisons and gameplay features in action.

#CrashTeamRacing #CTRTurbocharged #CTR
